entities.title: chess.js
entities.summary: The chess library the server judges moves with (BSD-2-Clause).
entities.relevance: play() and replay() make moves with Chess.move; boardOutcome() asks isCheckmate, isStalemate, isInsufficientMaterial, isThreefoldRepetition and isDrawByFiftyMoves. What chess.js counts as a draw is what the server counts.

entities.title: UCI move notation
entities.summary: Moves as from-square, to-square and an optional promotion piece: e2e4, e7e8q.
entities.relevance: Every move the API, the database and the transcript hold is in this notation (rules.ts UCI); Stockfish speaks it too.
